topic: Is a future of only self-driving cars realistic?
scoped_question: Under what safety, operational, infrastructure, communication, human-interaction, and public-legitimacy evidence conditions can an ADS mobility service expand its ODD and fleet share without converting an unvalidated capability into a city-wide or self-driving-only claim?
scientific_conclusion: An exclusive self-driving-car future is not currently a scientifically supported unitary target. Bounded ADS expansion can be researched through an assurance-gated, mixed-traffic transition process.
